description: Revoke the acceptance of a check on a crew's pull request, so it counts as failing again everywhere. Recorded in the audit trail. Requires `approve` scope.

checkName.description: The accepted check, exactly as it was accepted.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_revoke_crew_ci_check
title: Revoke crew ci check
